title: auto-refactor declarative configuration
description: Declarative registry for the auto-refactor static-analysis toolchain. Analyzers are registered purely by configuration; no engine code change is needed to add or enable one. All fields are optional — omitted values fall back to documented defaults.

format.description: Output format. 'sarif' is compatible with GitHub code scanning / CI dashboards; 'json' is the canonical machine-readable ScanReport; 'text' is human-readable.

failOnIssue.description: If true, the process exits non-zero when any 'error' issue is found (CI gate).

include.description: Glob patterns (relative to root); a file must match at least one to be scanned.

exclude.description: Glob patterns or directory names to skip.

thresholds.description: Global default thresholds; merged into every analyzer's ctx.options and overridable per-analyzer via analyzers.<name>.options.

magicNumberMin.description: constants: numeric literals with abs(value) < this are ignored.

duplicateLiteralThreshold.description: constants: a literal repeated >= this many times in a file becomes a duplicate-literal finding.

hardcodedStringMinLength.description: constants: minimum string length to be a hardcoded-string candidate.

fileLinesFail.description: large-file: lines at/above this => error (split candidate).

fileFunctionsWarn.description: large-file: top-level function count at/above this => warning.

complexityWarn.description: complexity: cyclomatic complexity at/above this => warning.

complexityFail.description: complexity: cyclomatic complexity at/above this => error.

analyzers.description: DECLARATIVE REGISTRY. Each key is an analyzer id (built-in name or custom name). Presence here = registered; enabled:false disables without removing. Per-analyzer `options` override global thresholds.

options.description: Per-analyzer options, deep-merged on top of global thresholds into ctx.options. Allowed keys mirror thresholds above plus analyzer-specific tunables.

customAnalyzers.description: EXTERNAL PLUG-INS. Each entry loads a module at runtime via require(module); the module must export a class/object implementing analyze(sf, ctx). No engine change needed.

name.description: Analyzer id; must match a key in analyzers to be enabled.

module.description: Module path (relative to this config file) or package specifier.

logLevel.description: Log verbosity. Logs go to stderr so stdout stays machine-readable; with logFile they also append to a file.

logFile.description: Optional log file (append). When set, logs mirror there in addition to stderr.

concurrency.description: File-level parallelism: max files analyzed concurrently. Default = min(4, os.cpus().length).

workers.description: Worker-thread parallelism for the parse+analyze stage. 1 = in-process single thread (default; fastest for typical repos, since parsing is already cheap once parent pointers are disabled). 0 = auto (spawn min(os.cpus().length, 8) worker threads when the repo is large). N > 1 = spawn exactly N worker threads — useful on many-core CI machines scanning very large codebases, where the fixed cost of loading TypeScript per worker is amortized. Files are independent so this parallelizes across cores.

respectGitignore.description: If true, honor a root-level .gitignore when discovering files, in addition to the exclude list. Prevents scanning generated/ignored artifacts (correctness + performance).

failOnAnalyzerError.description: If true, an analyzer that throws is reported as an 'error' Issue (can fail CI via failOnIssue). If false, such faults are reported as 'info' and never fail the build.

parser.description: TS/JS-family parser: 'typescript' (default, ts.createSourceFile) or 'oxc' (Rust oxc-parser engine). The oxc parser produces byte-equivalent normalized output (see docs/02-parsers-and-ast/02-oxc-fastpath.md) with ~3x faster parsing. Rust files are unaffected.

incremental.description: Line-level incremental switch (docs/03-incremental-and-diff/01-line-level-incremental.md). Default OFF. The runtime gate AR_INCREMENTAL=1 (environment) wins; this field is the declarative equivalent used by the daemon warm path. Only affects big-file-small-change rescans (daemon-only).

incrementalMinLines.description: Minimum file line count to attempt line-level incremental (docs/03-incremental-and-diff/01-line-level-incremental.md). Files below this threshold use the existing file-level L2 path (diff/cache-management would be net-negative).

cache.description: CLI/API warm-scan flag (NOT a ScanConfig field — accepted for CLI symmetry). Enables the two-level incremental cache (<root>/.auto-refactor-cache). CLI defaults to --cache; the scan() API defaults to off (zero implicit disk writes).

cacheDir.description: CLI/API warm-scan flag. Cache directory; default <root>/.auto-refactor-cache. A shared --cache-dir is namespaced per project by root-path hash.

cacheCustom.description: CLI/API warm-scan flag. When custom analyzers are present, L2 result caching is disabled by default (their purity cannot be proven). Set true to enable L2 by hashing each custom module's path + content + options into the cache key.

daemon.description: CLI/API warm-scan mode (NOT a ScanConfig field). 'off' (API default) never connects; 'auto' probes an EXISTING daemon only (CLI default, <5ms, no auto-start); 'on' auto-starts the daemon when missing (CLI --daemon).
